WORST SERVICE ever seen
Sep 2018 • Friends
I made the booking at this restaurant for 5 people, as suggested by a friend, on the occasion of our friend's birthday. When my wife & I arrived, seeing that the table set-up for us was not comfortable and asked the server if we could move to another section. The server's response was "that section is closed". However, 5 minutes later, a group of 6-7 people arrived and they were seated at the very section we wanted to move. What a lie by the server !!!! My wife was very upset and told the waiter that he lied and disrespected us (and throughout a 2-minute conversation, he did not even dare to look at us). 

Once the dinner was served (the food was fine, by the way), we asked the waiter (a new one, replacing the lying one) to pack some left-over food (quite a lot). As we were about to leave, we asked him where is our left-over food, his answer was, to our astonishment, "we already threw them in garbage", and as such, offered no apologies. My goodness !!!!!! What kind of service is this for a supposedly 5-star restaurant ???? In addition, we did request a red invoice, but by the time we were about to leave, there was no red invoice and nobody said a thing !!!!!!!!!! 

I, on behalf of my wife and friends, strongly recommend everyone who may think of having lunch/dinner at this restaurant to SERIOUSLY re-consider.

Great location...but what a horrible waste!
Jul 2017 • Family
This place can be so much better, due to its location and peaceful river views, but probably has the worst service of any restaurant in HCMC. We have been living in HCMC for 4 years, and initially liked the place due to these reasons, but gave up due to the horrible service. As we are now leaving Vietnam, we decided to give it another try, but guess what....some things do not change. 

My wife is allergic to seafood, and hence she ordered a safe dish...Chicken Pho. But, to her horror, after eating half her dish, she discovered shrimp in the soup. She called the waitress immediately. The waitress response was that my wife did not tell her about the allergy. In other words, she did not care and it was out fault. This got us both quite angry, and we asked to speak with the manager. In comes, another guy, who speaks zero English, with an aggressive speaking style. This got us more angry. All this time about half a dozen staff are standing around mumbling in Vietnamese. 

Finally, as we were ready to leave, since we were sitting outside and my wife could feel the itchiness, a calm lady named Ms Phuong came in, who apologised and explained. Not that it was enough but she tried her best to understand.

This restaurant has the worst service culture, for a long time, and relies on marriage and other events for its survival. Hence, the normal guests do not matter. There is only way to send the message about service....boycott all events.

What a disappointment!!!
Jun 2017 • Family
This evening with my wife and child, we decided to see some dear friends off. They had spent a number of years in Vietnam. We all thought a goodbye meal was a good idea. The service was lousy the staff had a poor grasp of English and they didn't seem to be anyone managing the restaurant. The idiot that was supposed to be managing may of took his badge off/Name tag. 
 The food was not fresh. Out of seven meals that were ordered four was passable. i ordered a chicken fried rice with Thai green curry. It should've been called "no chicken cold dried rice, no green curry. I got what resembled Fried rice with some small bits of dried meat which might have been chicken, though it was hard to tell there was so little of the meat. The green curry was non-existent. My complaint was treated with contempt. In short the staff couldn't care less!
Not a good experience!!! An evening to remember, or rather to forget. Probably a high turnover of staff and management.
Good luck to anyone dining at this establishment, they will need it!.
